title: Slender young trees before the Pullman estate
items: The parkway trees on 18th Street before the Pullman palm house and stable, and the two at the Calumet Avenue corner, now stand as the slender young elms the 1890s photographs show — single straight trunks about a foot across and 10–14 m tall — in place of thick, forked full-grown elms.
The one big tree the 1894 Inland Architect plate shows full-crowned there stays a grown elm.
